Для того, чтобы жидкость испарялась, ей: For a liquid to evaporate, it must be supplied with heat — this energy is spent overcoming the intermolecular attraction forces in the liquid state. The stronger the bond between molecules, the more energy must be supplied to a molecule. An individual molecule overcomes the attraction of other molecules thanks to its kinetic energy (which is proportional to temperature). Therefore, the stronger the bond between molecules, the higher the heat of vaporization and boiling temperature. Consequently, the heat of vaporization should increase with temperature.
